title: Male Anglerfish Fuse Into the Female's Body and Never Let Go

scenes.text: Male anglerfish permanently melt into the female's body.
Down in the dark, he bites onto her side and never lets go.
His mouth fuses to her skin. Then his blood vessels join hers.
His organs shrivel, and he lives off her blood.
She can be sixty times bigger than he is, and carry up to eight males.
They even lost immune system genes, which may be why she doesn't reject him.
A fish that became a permanent part of someone else.

description:
In the most extreme anglerfish species, the male bites a female and his bloodstream fuses with hers.
Researchers found these fish lost genes for the adaptive immune response.
Can you believe that is real?
first_comment: What is the weirdest deep sea animal you know?
